items.difficulty_reason: Two-stage proof: first, for a single surjective flat lfp qcqs cover a, the Cech exact sequence 0 -> F -> a_*a^*F -> b_*b^*F is quoted, b^*F is lqc as a pullback of a^*F, the pushforwards are lqc by the pushforward-lqc lemma, and F is lqc by the lqc-colimits lemma closing the sequence; second, the general case is reduced by Zariski-localizing to affine U and refining the fppp covering to a standard one, i.e. pullback by a disjoint union of the covering pieces is lqc, and the first paragraph applies.
